fact: IGN FI reports the official launch on 27 July 2026 of the Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS) project in Zanzibar, with aerial mapping starting to provide the foundation for Zanzibar's Digital Land Information System, funded by BPI and CRDB Bank.
system: Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS)

fact: LARIS, an integrated land information system being built by IGN FI for Zanzibar over June 2026 to May 2028, will bring together land ownership, surveying, urban planning, registration and land-use information, per its coordinator.
